items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] In the early 1980’s, it seems another wave of popularity for you. “Women Blow Their Own Horns,” part of George Wein’s July 3, 1981 Kool Jazz Festival. Did that open new doors for you... [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, and I think…that’s what they called the show?

ctx.x: Nellie Lutcher, (sings). Everybody’s got a gimmick.

In the early 1980’s, it seems another wave of popularity for you. “Women Blow Their Own Horns,” part of George Wein’s July 3, 1981 Kool Jazz Festival. Did that open new doors for you, expose you to a new audience?
Yes, and I think…that’s what they called the show? What’s his name, who wrote it?
